skill.name: set-up-lightspeed-google-ads-enhanced-conversions
skill.description: Set up and troubleshoot Google Ads Enhanced Conversions for Lightspeed eCom C-Series through Product Metrics. Check consent settings, Google customer data terms, and test order delivery.
skill.summary: Configure consent and verify Enhanced Conversions for Lightspeed orders in Google Ads.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: The reconnaissance and most backtick flags are setup prose, scoped reads, or Markdown references. The skill does direct agents to a remote API, live order lookups, and an unpinned installer. Credential handling, write approval, trust in remote instructions, and consent verification need stronger safeguards.

remediation.issue: The skill permits agent handling of integration secrets.
remediation.suggestion: Require credential entry in the verified Product Metrics app or a protected secret field. Keep credentials out of chat, command arguments, and agent tool traces.

remediation.issue: Product Metrics writes lack a general approval step.
remediation.suggestion: Start with read-only checks. Show the exact workspace, property, destination, and proposed effect before asking for approval for each material change.

remediation.issue: Order checks can retrieve unrelated production orders and commercial details.
remediation.suggestion: Verify only the known test order in the approved property. Redact customer and financial details and report only whether the order arrived.

remediation.issue: The installation example resolves executable dependencies and skill content without a version pin.
remediation.suggestion: Use a reviewed installer release and immutable skill revision. Keep installation manual and separate from the setup workflow.

remediation.issue: The workflow trusts remote reference content and tool-provided browser links.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle reviewed instructions and restrict browser steps to verified vendor destinations. Do not accept new executable instructions from remote documentation or tool responses.

remediation.issue: The readiness check does not verify that opted-out data is withheld.
remediation.suggestion: Use synthetic orders to test granted and denied consent paths. Verify data suppression without displaying real order payloads or customer identifiers.

semantic_findings.title: Conflicting instructions for integration secrets
semantic_findings.description: The main skill allows agents to request Lightspeed credentials and pass them to a command. The setup guide instead requires app entry and warns against chat. The exception could expose credentials through chat, tool traces, or process arguments.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The exception and the app-only warning are explicit. The skill does not specify a protected input channel for the command.

semantic_findings.title: Delegated writes lack explicit approval
semantic_findings.description: The skill gates deletes, browser steps, and primary conversion choices, but does not require approval for other Product Metrics writes. Following setup status can lead to changes in the selected workspace without a separate user decision.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The write rule addresses retries and names specific human-only actions. It does not require agents to confirm the target and effect before other writes.

semantic_findings.title: Remote setup instructions are not verified
semantic_findings.description: The fallback treats mutable vendor documentation as equivalent to the reviewed local guide. It also passes tool-provided browser links to the user without describing destination checks.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The file explicitly uses both remote documents and returned links without a revision pin or destination validation. No malicious response was observed.

semantic_findings.title: Setup checks do not verify consent enforcement
semantic_findings.description: The guide checks the selected consent banner, account readiness, and test order arrival. It does not test whether denied ad user data consent suppresses customer data before rollout.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documented test confirms delivery and live endpoints without testing denied consent. This is a verification gap, not evidence of unauthorized transmission.

content.user_title: Set Up Lightspeed Enhanced Conversions for Google Ads
content.value_statement: Google Ads can miss Lightspeed purchases when cookies alone cannot link them to an ad click. Use Product Metrics to configure and verify Enhanced Conversions for orders with ad user data consent.
actual_capabilities: Read Product Metrics setup status through the CLI or MCP and identify completed steps.
Check whether the linked Lightspeed store and Google Ads account have server-side conversion tracking in place.
Guide the user to select the consent banner their storefront actually uses.
Explain how an administrator accepts Google customer data terms and rechecks Data Manager readiness.
Guide verification of a paid test order and the storefront tracking endpoints.
Explain which order fields are hashed, which are sent unhashed, and how consent affects delivery.
limitations: Supports Lightspeed eCom C-Series through Product Metrics Pro, not other Lightspeed products.
Requires existing server-side tracking and a Cloudflare-proxied shop domain. Google Ads setup also requires linked Merchant Center access.
The user must complete store and ad platform approvals. The skill does not accept terms or make conversion actions primary.
A Ready status does not guarantee attribution for an individual order. Customer Match and bidding are outside this skill.

use_cases.title: Check setup readiness
use_cases.description: Identify which prerequisites are complete and which steps an administrator still needs to finish.

use_cases.title: Resolve a Google Ads status warning
use_cases.description: Use the Enhanced Conversions status to check terms acceptance and identify when to recheck Data Manager.

use_cases.title: Verify tracking after setup
use_cases.description: Confirm a paid test order reached the linked property and check the storefront tracking endpoints.

prompt_templates.title: List the prerequisites
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain what I need before I can set up Enhanced Conversions for Lightspeed eCom C-Series. Do not access or change any account.

prompt_templates.title: Check my setup status
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the Product Metrics setup status for my selected property. Tell me which steps are complete and which require my approval. Do not make changes.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a readiness warning
prompt_templates.prompt: Product Metrics shows Action required for Enhanced Conversions. Help me distinguish missing customer data terms from rejected Data Manager acceptance. Leave Google Ads changes to me.

prompt_templates.title: Review a paid test order
prompt_templates.prompt: Use only my known paid test order and linked property to check tracking. Explain what the observed status proves and what remains unverified. Do not display customer details or change settings.

output_examples.input: Product Metrics says customer data terms are managed on another account. What should I do?
output: Ask a Google Ads administrator to open the manager account named in Product Metrics and review and accept the customer data terms there.
Return to Tracking, then Google Ads in Product Metrics, and select Re-check. Look for Ready under Enhanced conversions.

output_examples.input: My paid test order arrived in the linked property. Does that prove Google Ads matched it?
output: Order arrival confirms that Product Metrics received your paid test order. It does not confirm an ad match in Google Ads.
Check the Enhanced conversions status and confirm that Live endpoints lists the Tracking SDK and Event collector on your shop domain.

best_practices: Confirm the workspace, linked property, and Google Ads client account before proceeding.
Enter Lightspeed credentials only in the verified Product Metrics app.
Match the selected consent banner to the storefront and verify tracking with a dedicated paid test order.
anti_patterns: Pasting API keys, secrets, or customer data into chat.
Choosing a consent banner that the storefront does not use.
Treating a Ready status or a received test order as proof that Google Ads attributed the purchase.

faq.question: Which Lightspeed stores are supported?
faq.answer: The guide supports Lightspeed eCom C-Series stores on the Europe or United States cluster.

faq.question: Do I need Google Tag Manager?
faq.answer: No. Product Metrics sends Enhanced Conversions data server-side through Google Ads Data Manager.

faq.question: Which consent banners are supported?
faq.answer: The guide lists OneTrust, Cookiebot, Usercentrics, and Osano.

faq.question: What customer data is sent?
faq.answer: With ad user data consent, Product Metrics sends available email, phone, and names as hashes. Country and postcode are unhashed when sent with a complete name and address field set.

faq.question: What happens if a visitor declines ad user data consent?
faq.answer: If the visitor allows ad storage, the order can still be sent without Enhanced Conversions customer fields. If neither is allowed, the order is not sent.

faq.question: Who can accept Google customer data terms?
faq.answer: An administrator accepts the terms in Google Ads. Use the manager account if Product Metrics shows that it manages the terms.
